title: The attract board card is one menu width and its empty line is the body size
why: The critic scored the attract board 2 of 5: an 845px card (44% of the screen) held two short lines with a huge empty right side, and the empty line was 18px, off the 20/16 scale. A page with no table is now one menu width (560 times the menu scale), the empty line is the 20px body size times the scale. The how to play page keeps its width. No wording moved.
now: The score board card is narrower and its text is the standard size.

edits.replacement: body #attract .arcpage .apn{ color:var(--tx-2); opacity:1; line-height:1.4; font-size:calc(var(--fs-body) * var(--attz,1)); }
